mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in quarterly demand (GDPC1) signals an expanding economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 growth rate falls below 2% in the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 4.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent easing in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <3%) and robust demand growth (GDPC1 >5%) creates a favorable environment for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both FEDFUNDS <3% and GDPC1 growth >5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates above 4.0% trigger negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of tightening regime instances despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 4.0% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly supply growth (INDPRO >5% YoY) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when INDPRO growth rate falls below 1% in the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment below 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE remaining above 4.8% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in labor employment (PAYEMS >5k) and falling unemployment (UNRATE <4.5%) creates a positive S&P 500 return environment over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >5k and UNRATE falls below 4.5%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both PAYEMS increases by >5k and UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained demand growth (GDPC1 >5%) alongside low inflation (CPIAUCSL <2%) drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of late-cycle instances despite meeting the trigger conditions (GDPC1 growth >5% and CPIAUCSL <2%).
